description: The classic 15-puzzle — a guaranteed-solvable shuffle, move counter, and win detection on a 4×4 grid.

faqs.a: The board is shuffled by making hundreds of random legal moves from the solved state, so every puzzle is solvable.
Tap a tile next to the empty space to slide it in. Arrange 1–15 in order with the gap bottom-right.
No — the move counter tracks your efficiency. Try to beat your best!
Yes — press New Game for a fresh guaranteed-solvable shuffle.

howto: Press New Game for a fresh shuffle.
Tap tiles next to the empty space to slide them.
Get the gap to the bottom-right to win!
title: Sliding Puzzle (15 Puzzle)
